outreach_draft.subject: A thought on your Family Law page
outreach_draft.body:
Roger,

I was looking through the Law Offices of Rogelio Herrera site and noticed Family Law, Criminal Law, and Personal Injury are all presented through the same general Services page rather than having their own focused client pages.

Those are very different conversations. Someone dealing with divorce, custody, or child support is arriving with very different questions and priorities from someone facing a criminal charge or recovering from an accident.

A dedicated Family Law page could speak directly to that person, give Google a focused page to crawl and index, and give AI tools clearer context around that part of your practice.

I’m using Family Law as the first mockup because the contrast with Criminal and Personal Injury makes the idea easy to see while keeping the firm’s current positioning intact.

I’m putting together a quick mockup to show you what I mean. I’ll send it over in the next couple of days.

If you’d rather I didn’t, just let me know.
